# InterMiles

> > InterMiles is a travel and lifestyle rewards program offering miles on everyday spending with partners like Zomato, Swiggy, and Indian Oil, while providing comprehensive travel guides across India and international destinations.

The platform combines a loyalty rewards app with extensive travel content, featuring destination guides for Indian tourist spots (Rajasthan, Nainital, Ooty, Hampi), budget travel tips, and cultural experiences. InterMiles helps users earn and redeem miles while planning memorable journeys through detailed guides on attractions, hotels, shopping, and local experiences.

## Key Topics

- InterMiles rewards program
- India travel destinations
- Rajasthan tourism (Chittorgarh, Udaipur)
- Hill stations (Nainital, Ooty, Gangtok)
- Budget travel planning
- Zomato and Swiggy partnerships
- Indian Oil rewards
- Historical forts and temples
- Luxury hotels and accommodations
- Post-COVID travel incentives
- Cultural festivals (Nagaland)
- Karnataka tourism (Hampi)
- Travel guides and itineraries
- Shopping and food experiences
- Lake-view destinations
